patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layout where the left column contains section titles and the right column displays horizontally scrollable image galleries.
Each content section features a horizontal scroll container for a collection of images, allowing users to browse within a category without vertical scrolling.
All UI text, including navigation and section titles, uses a consistent uppercase sans-serif font, contributing to a clean, editorial aesthetic.
The user interface is strictly monochromatic (black text on white background), allowing the vibrant and diverse colors within the photographic content to serve as the primary visual accents.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining constant access to site navigation as the user scrolls vertically through content sections.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed header element that stays at the top of the viewport, ensuring navigation links are always visible.

Structure content into distinct vertical sections, each containing a horizontally scrollable container. Within these containers, arrange images in a flexible grid that adapts to various aspect ratios, allowing for a dynamic, collage-like presentation without strict alignment.

design_tokens.type_scale: A relatively flat sans-serif type scale with uppercase headings and labels, maintaining a consistent, minimal visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant white space around content blocks and a wide left margin for section titles, creating a gallery-like feel.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its stark, almost brutalist black-and-white UI, which serves as a minimalist frame for rich, horizontally scrollable photographic galleries. The asymmetrical layout, with section titles anchored to the far left, creates a unique visual rhythm that elevates the content.
